question: I was asking about the journey. Are there things from the ride or the wait that you keep thinking about afterward?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: On Monday, two people at the shelter looked up at the same time, and I felt singled out. I moved to the other end. I keep wondering whether they recognized me, though they might just have been looking for the bus. I’m still not sure.
